comparisons.orientation: Chronos minus ridge; negative means Chronos had the lower loss

comparisons.orientation: Chronos risk-weighted minus Chronos risk-neutral: the price of risk aversion on the Chronos scenarios
ridge risk-weighted minus ridge risk-neutral: the price of risk aversion on the ridge scenarios

risk_weighted_planner.objective: (1 - risk_weight) x expected scenario cost + risk_weight x CVaR of scenario cost at cvar_beta (mizan.rasid.solver.solve)
risk_weighted_planner.rule: When every scenario weighs at least 1 - cvar_beta, the worst 1 - cvar_beta of the scenario distribution lies inside the single costliest scenario, so the CVaR term equals that scenario's cost.
risk_weighted_planner.settings_from: mizan.examples.settings(24), which mizan.evaluation.policy_problem uses for the candidate and chronos policies

bootstrap.interval: 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles of the resampled mean daily difference (a minus b)

source.note: Derived from the per-origin values already in the evidence files; no model was run and the evidence files are unchanged. Days are dependent through carried battery state and the monthly peak, so whole weeks are resampled, as for the paired cost intervals. 'resolved' means the 95% interval excludes zero.
